max (eng-runtime): seeing a hard p99 jump on prod-gpu-pool-12, started ~10:03 UTC. p50/p90 fine, p99 from 220ms -> 1.1s. Anyone touching batching/kernel selection?
anya (eng-runtime): noted. no deliberate config changes from runtime team in last 24h. any recent model rollouts pinned to different kernels?
max (eng-runtime): not that I'm aware of. metrics:
```
pool=prod-gpu-pool-12 seq_len<=64: p50 48ms p90 90ms p99 1100ms
requests/sec dropped ~10% concurrently with p99 rise
kernel_switches/sec spike +4x
kv_cache_evictions spike +2.2x
```
maria (eng-ml): could be noisy tenant causing cache thrash. which tenants on that shard? link: https://dash.internal/redwood/runtime/pools/12/metrics
sam (eng-infra): awk of allocation shows tenant-420 and tenant-117 increased short sequences burst around 10:02. noisy_job-117 has many shortseq requests.
ops (eng-sre): incident-bot: creating incident INC-20231005-01 (latency spike prod-gpu-pool-12). priority P1.
incident-bot: INC-20231005-01 created by ops. responders: eng-runtime, eng-infra, eng-ml.
anya (eng-runtime): quick triage: kernel selector seems to be oscillating between cudakernel-v2 and cudakernel-v1 on short sequences. cudakernel-v2 has worse cold KV cache behavior for shortseq (known regression in 2.14).
max (eng-runtime): profiling (flame diff) attached:
```
flame summary: cudakernel-v2: 62% time in KV lookup path, backpressure stalls on batch assembly; cudakernel-v1: 18% time in KV path, faster path for short seqs
heap allocs during spike +30% in common allocator
```
maria (eng-ml): that matches perf regression we saw in canary last week for <32 tokens. we flagged cudakernel-v2 for rework but it auto-targeted some pools via selector rule quantile_95_optimistic.
sam (eng-infra): I can route new requests away from pool-12 to pool-8 temporarily. ops, want me to warm fallback pools?
ops (eng-sre): yes please. start routing 30% of incoming traffic from pool-12 -> pool-8 and enable emergency throttle on tenant-117.
max (eng-runtime): suggested mitigations: 1) disable quantile_95_optimistic selector for pool-12 (FF) 2) emergency throttle noisy tenant 117 3) route a fraction away 4) if that fails, pin pool-12 to cudakernel-v1 via kernel-override.
anya (eng-runtime): I'll toggle the FF first. command: 
```bash
./ff toggle --name=quantile_95_optimistic --scope=pool-12 --state=off --by=max
```
anya (eng-runtime): done. selector rule removed for pool-12. watch metrics.
incident-bot: feature-flag quantile_95_optimistic disabled for pool-12 by anya at 10:12 UTC.
sam (eng-infra): routing change in flight: `route-adjust --from=pool-12 --to=pool-8 --percent=30` -> applied.
ops (eng-sre): noisy tenant throttle: `tenantctl throttle tenant-117 --limit 5rps` applied.
max (eng-runtime): after FF toggle and route/throttle: p99 back to ~200ms -> 260ms, requests/sec recovered to -2% from -10%. kv evictions down 45%. good sign.
maria (eng-ml): confirm cudakernel-v2 still enabled globally?
anya (eng-runtime): yes still enabled globally, just removed optimistic selector for pool-12. we should patch cudakernel-v2 KV path but that's medium-term.
ops (eng-sre): can we add a temporary kernel-override so pool-12 pins to cudakernel-v1 until the kernel fixes land? safer than leaving partial routing.
max (eng-runtime): I can do kernel-override: `runtimectl set-kernel pool-12 cudakernel-v1 --reason="INC-20231005-01 mitigation"`. will apply a rolling restart of worker daemons. ops, expect brief connection churn on pool-12.
ops (eng-sre): do it with 10s drain windows. coordinate with infra to avoid evict storms.
max (eng-runtime): starting override now. restarting workers 1-by-1.
incident-bot: kernel-override applied to pool-12 by max. rolling restarts started.
sam (eng-infra): observing ~3xx reconnections for short window, nothing alarming.
max (eng-runtime): after override complete p99 stabilized to 120-180ms and throughput fully recovered. will monitor for 6 hours.
maria (eng-ml): filing follow-up: create a perf ticket to revert the optimistic quantile selector rule until cudakernel-v2 KV path is fixed, and add a regression test for shortseq <32 tokens. ticket: PERF-7842.
anya (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) revert selector config in config-repo (PR incoming) 2) add canary test that runs shortseq workload against cudakernel-v2 3) track kernel rollout automation to avoid optimistic switches during high eviction windows.
max (eng-runtime): thanks team. putting incident to monitoring state. ops to close when stable.
ops (eng-sre): INC-20231005-01 -> monitoring. will close if stable for 2h. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INC-20231005-01 status changed to MONITORING by ops at 12:08 UTC.
